purpose: Four fixed diagnostic trials; both labels run the same baseline application. No promotion estimator or qualification inference.
qualification: Existing provisional A/A remains inconclusive and incomplete. No fresh calibration/comparison or implementation PR from this diagnostic study.

sql.interpretation: Actual plans retain temporary B-trees. Main-thread aggregate stacks include SQLite sorter flushes through pwrite. Native counter windows corroborate file I/O during long synchronous list SQL; they do not assign all waiting to a particular request or retroactively explain every older outlier.

connections.interpretation: Load fills the listener accept queue while synchronous SQL occupies the API. Matched client writes precede runtime acceptance and HTTP parsing by tens of seconds. Native milestones are not packet timestamps or proof of a particular retransmission cause.
connections.analysisCorrection: Preliminary analysis-1 omitted those 28 timings. Analysis-3 uses unique request IDs with agreement checks on available ports; ambiguous or contradictory matches fail. Same four raw trials; regression coverage added.
